     (= CONFIG_FORCE_MAX_ZONEORDER false)
     (= CONFIG_SLOB true)
     (= CONFIG_SLAB false)
     (= CONFIG_PPC_256K_PAGES true))

  false)
(define-fun CONFIG_SLOB () Bool
  true)
(define-fun CONFIG_PPC_256K_PAGES () Bool
  true)
(define-fun CONFIG_LOCKDEP () Bool
  true)
(define-fun CONFIG_FORCE_MAX_ZONEORDER () Bool

reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (OVER-CONSTRAINED): Same bug as PRODUCT_108 (0f8f8094d28.c, Linux kmalloc). Line 36 accesses kmalloc_caches[i] inside #ifdef CONFIG_LOCKDEP, but kmalloc_caches is declared inside #ifndef CONFIG_SLOB. When SLOB=true, kmalloc_caches is undeclared, and the tool detects accessing it as PULSE_UNINITIALIZED_VALUE on 'cache'. This is the known vbdb OutOfBoundsRead/UndeclaredIdentifier bug — real bug when LOCKDEP=true && SLOB=true. OVER-CONSTRAINED: The core condition is LOCKDEP=true && SLOB=true; the additional flags FORCE_MAX_ZONEORDER=false, PPC_256K_PAGES=true, SLAB=false do not gate the buggy code path and unnecessarily restrict the presence condition.
